title: AegisTARA demo library
sources: Written for AegisTARA from public sources: attack pattern titles of MITRE CAPEC (free to use with attribution) and the threat categories of UN Regulation No. 155 Annex 5. The wording is original; no text of ISO/SAE 21434 is included.

items.name: Reach the OBD port
items.notes: The attacker plugs a tool into the diagnostic connector. Whether this is easy depends on where the connector is and on who can reach the vehicle.

items.name: Flood the bus with high-priority frames
aliases: 高優先度フレームでバスを溢れさせる
items.notes: Frames with a low identifier win arbitration, so a node that sends them without pause starves the others.

tree.label: Flood the bus with high-priority frames

items.name: Phish an operator account
aliases: オペレーターアカウントのフィッシング
items.notes: A message that looks like it comes from the company asks an operator to sign in on a fake page.

items.name: Guess a weak diagnostic PIN
items.notes: Short or shared PINs can be tried one after another when there is no lockout.

items.name: Denial of service on a CAN bus
aliases: CANバスへのサービス妨害
items.notes: Several ways to make a CAN bus unusable. Pick the ones that apply to the bus the item is connected to.

tree.label: Deny service on the CAN bus

children.label: Flood the bus with high-priority frames

aliases: デバッグポートからの鍵の抽出
